commentary: With market breadth moderating to 54 and the Nifty retreating 0.61% amid macroeconomic headwinds, William O'Neil's golden rule applies: three out of four stocks follow the market's trend. The scanner's CAUTION gate dictates strict risk management and selective progressive exposure. Stan Weinstein's Stage Analysis reminds us never to fight an overarching index consolidation or chase extended names. We demand textbook Stage 2 structures supported by accelerating quarterly earnings and verified volume demand. While high-inflation prints and defensive sector rotation warrant defensive position sizing, true market leaders like AARTIPHARM and ABCAPITAL display classic institutional accumulation. Protect capital by respecting predetermined stops and waiting for confirmed follow-through.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Cleared cup-and-handle neckline above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. RSI at 63 shows firm momentum without immediate extension, confirming a valid technical pivot above 982.83.
63MOONS.fundamental: Revenue improved marginally by 2.3% YoY to Rs 136 crore, but net profit collapsed into deep negative territory with operating losses. Fails CANSLIM bottom-line requirements.
63MOONS.risk: Failure below 886.75 invalidates the handle support. Execute immediate stop discipline if base breakdown occurs.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of 20-day pivot at 114.91 with volume expanding to 1.66x average. Price holds above major moving averages, though base lacks institutional accumulation characteristics.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Top-line contracted sharply by 56.3% YoY with thin operating margins near 1.5% and poor return ratios (ROE 2.8%). Lacks fundamental sponsorship required by CANSLIM criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breach below 104.57 violates the pivot base low; exit immediately to preserve capital.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Constructive double-bottom consolidation right at the 513.51 pivot, tracking above rising 21 EMA and 50/200 SMAs. MACD bullish crossover above zero signals gathering momentum.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Outstanding Q2 turnaround with sales up 27% to Rs 829 crore and PAT up 83%. EBITDA margin expanded 370 bps to 16.6%, signaling strong operating leverage across APIs and formulations.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Close below 455.37 breaks swing support, demanding strict stop-loss execution.

AARTIPHARM.technical: High-volume SEPA breakout to 52-week highs at 1003.4 on 2.96x volume. Flawless Stage 2 structure comfortably above upward-sloping 50 and 200 SMAs with exceptional relative strength.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM profile. Q2 revenue surged 47% YoY to Rs 613 crore, driven by CDMO expansion and xanthine volume, while PAT leapt 175% with EBITDA margins widening to 22.2%.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Violation of 907.75 stop invalidates breakout thrust; close the position immediately without hesitation.

AARVI.technical: Coiling constructively within 1.5% of its 161.16 pivot. Aligned swing lows and positive MACD confirm underlying accumulation, holding firmly above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA.
AARVI.fundamental: Manpower services revenue grew 14.1% YoY to Rs 172.7 crore with Q1 PAT up 41.9%. Thin OPM (2.6%) and decelerating growth from prior triples require margin execution before leadership status.
AARVI.risk: Drop below 146.04 breaks support structure; honor the stop-loss to manage downside exposure.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Explosive SEPA breakout clearing 20-session high at 416.87 on 2.87x volume expansion. Classic Stage 2 trend alignment with rising moving averages and robust relative strength.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Powerhouse financial performance with Q2 lending AUM up 32% YoY. Revenue increased 31% to Rs 16,545 crore while consolidated PAT expanded 38% to Rs 1,288 crore, reflecting scalable operating efficiency.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Breakdown below 390.48 negates the breakout pivot; enforce disciplined capital protection immediately.
